purpose: Compare parameter-matched MERA and MPS at matched aggregate SU(4)-shot-gate exposure without changing the frozen optimizer trajectory.
checkpoint_rule: For architecture A, save the first completed SPSA step for which achieved_training_shots times physical_su4_blocks is at least the common target G.

seed_policy.description: This reuses the exact deterministic seed labels from measurement_budget_v1; it is a resource-normalized rerun, not an independent confirmation.

statistics.pooled_estimand: Equal-field-weight mean paired difference over the three fixed fields; not arbitrary-field generalization.

guardrails: No budget-specific hyperparameter or optimizer change is allowed.
All requested and achieved training-shot and gate-exposure values are reported.
Intermediate common-cost points are descriptive; the largest common-cost point is primary.
MERA_PM225 minus MPS is the difference convention; negative long-range error favors MERA.
The comparison matches aggregate idealized SU(4)-shot-gate exposure, not physical device noise or wall-clock latency.
